@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+# Dependency Planner
+
+Dependency-free Bun TypeScript CLI that validates a task dependency graph and produces a deterministic execution plan.
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts plan INPUT.json
+```
+
+Input is JSON with a `tasks` array. Each task has a unique non-empty `id`, a finite non-negative `duration`, and optional `dependsOn` array:
+
+```json
+{"tasks":[{"id":"lint","duration":1},{"id":"build","duration":3,"dependsOn":["lint"]}]}
+```
+
+The command writes exactly one JSON result to stdout. Invalid input, invalid arguments, and cycles fail non-zero with an explanation on stderr.

1: type Task = {
2:   id: string;
3:   duration: number;
4:   dependsOn: string[];

7: type Plan = {
8:   order: string[];
9:   layers: string[][];
10:   earliest: Record<string, { start: number; finish: number }>;
11:   totalDuration: number;
12:   criticalPath: string[];
13: };
14: 
15: function fail(message: string): never {
16:   console.error(message);
17:   process.exit(1);
18: }
19: 
20: function validate(input: unknown): Task[] {
21:   if (typeof input !== "object" || input === null || Array.isArray(input)) {
22:     fail("Invalid input: expected an object with a tasks array.");
23:   }
24: 
25:   const tasksValue = (input as Record<string, unknown>).tasks;
26:   if (!Array.isArray(tasksValue)) fail("Invalid input: tasks must be an array.");
27: 
28:   const ids = new Set<string>();
29:   const tasks: Task[] = tasksValue.map((value, index) => {
30:     if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
31:       fail(`Invalid task at index ${index}: expected an object.`);
32:     }
33:     const raw = value as Record<string, unknown>;
34:     if (typeof raw.id !== "string" || raw.id.length === 0) {
35:       fail(`Invalid task at index ${index}: id must be a non-empty string.`);
36:     }
37:     if (ids.has(raw.id)) fail(`Invalid input: duplicate task id ${JSON.stringify(raw.id)}.`);
38:     ids.add(raw.id);
39: 
40:     if (typeof raw.duration !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(raw.duration) || raw.duration < 0) {
41:       fail(`Invalid task ${JSON.stringify(raw.id)}: duration must be a finite non-negative number.`);
42:     }
43: 
44:     const dependsOn = raw.dependsOn === undefined ? [] : raw.dependsOn;
45:     if (!Array.isArray(dependsOn) || !dependsOn.every((id) => typeof id === "string")) {
46:       fail(`Invalid task ${JSON.stringify(raw.id)}: dependsOn must be an array of strings.`);
47:     }
48:     if (new Set(dependsOn).size !== dependsOn.length) {
49:       fail(`Invalid task ${JSON.stringify(raw.id)}: dependsOn entries must be unique.`);
50:     }
51:     if (dependsOn.includes(raw.id)) {
52:       fail(`Invalid task ${JSON.stringify(raw.id)}: a task cannot depend on itself.`);
53:     }
54:     return { id: raw.id, duration: raw.duration, dependsOn };
55:   });
56: 
57:   for (const task of tasks) {
58:     for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) {
59:       if (!ids.has(dependency)) {
60:         fail(`Invalid task ${JSON.stringify(task.id)}: unknown dependency ${JSON.stringify(dependency)}.`);
61:       }
62:     }
63:   }
64:   return tasks;
65: }
66: 
67: function findCycle(tasks: Task[], byId: Map<string, Task>): string[] | undefined {
68:   const state = new Map<string, number>();
69:   const stack: string[] = [];
70:   const visit = (id: string): string[] | undefined => {
71:     state.set(id, 1);
72:     stack.push(id);
73:     for (const dependency of [...byId.get(id)!.dependsOn].sort()) {
74:       if (state.get(dependency) === 1) return [...stack.slice(stack.indexOf(dependency)), dependency];
75:       if (!state.has(dependency)) {
76:         const cycle = visit(dependency);
77:         if (cycle) return cycle;
78:       }
79:     }
80:     stack.pop();
81:     state.set(id, 2);
82:   };
83:   for (const task of [...tasks].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))) {
84:     if (!state.has(task.id)) {
85:       const cycle = visit(task.id);
86:       if (cycle) return cycle;
87:     }
88:   }
89: }
90: 
91: function plan(tasks: Task[]): Plan {
92:   const byId = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, task]));
93:   const cycle = findCycle(tasks, byId);
94:   if (cycle) fail(`Cycle detected: ${cycle.join(" -> ")}`);
95: 
96:   const dependents = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, [] as string[]]));
97:   const remaining = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, task.dependsOn.length]));
98:   for (const task of tasks) for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) dependents.get(dependency)!.push(task.id);
99: 
100:   const ready = tasks.filter((task) => task.dependsOn.length === 0).map((task) => task.id).sort();
101:   const order: string[] = [];
102:   while (ready.length > 0) {
103:     const id = ready.shift()!;
104:     order.push(id);
105:     for (const dependent of dependents.get(id)!.sort()) {
106:       const count = remaining.get(dependent)! - 1;
107:       remaining.set(dependent, count);
108:       if (count === 0) {
109:         ready.push(dependent);
110:         ready.sort();
111:       }
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   const earliest: Plan["earliest"] = {};
116:   const paths = new Map<string, string[]>();
117:   const layers: string[][] = [];
118:   let totalDuration = 0;
119:   let criticalPath: string[] = [];
120:   for (const id of order) {
121:     const task = byId.get(id)!;
122:     let start = 0;
123:     let layer = 0;
124:     let bestPath: string[] = [];
125:     for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) {
126:       const candidateFinish = earliest[dependency].finish;
127:       const candidatePath = paths.get(dependency)!;
128:       if (candidateFinish > start || (candidateFinish === start && candidatePath.join("\0") < bestPath.join("\0"))) {
129:         start = candidateFinish;
130:         bestPath = candidatePath;
131:       }
132:       layer = Math.max(layer, layers.findIndex((items) => items.includes(dependency)) + 1);
133:     }
134:     const finish = start + task.duration;
135:     earliest[id] = { start, finish };
136:     paths.set(id, [...bestPath, id]);
137:     (layers[layer] ??= []).push(id);
138:     const path = paths.get(id)!;
139:     if (finish > totalDuration || (finish === totalDuration && path.join("\0") < criticalPath.join("\0"))) {
140:       totalDuration = finish;
141:       criticalPath = path;
142:     }
143:   }
144:   for (const layer of layers) layer.sort();
145:   return { order, layers, earliest, totalDuration, criticalPath };
146: }
147: 
148: const args = process.argv.slice(2);
149: if (args.length !== 2 || args[0] !== "plan" || args[1].startsWith("-")) {
150:   fail("Usage: bun run src/cli.ts plan INPUT.json");
151: }
152: 
153: let parsed: unknown;
154: try {
155:   parsed = JSON.parse(await Bun.file(args[1]).text());
156: } catch (error) {
157:   fail(`Unable to read valid JSON from ${JSON.stringify(args[1])}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
158: }
159: console.log(JSON.stringify(plan(validate(parsed))));
